description: Intent i017 (firmware-table-divisor, snapshot s04) complete. Primary finding: drivers/gpu/drm/nouveau/nvkm/subdev/volt/gk104.c gk104_volt_set() line 59 `div = 27648000 / bios->pwm_freq;` and line 60 `DIV_ROUND_UP((uv - bios->base) * div, bios->pwm_range)` divide by fields parsed straight from the GPU VBIOS by nvbios_volt_parse (drivers/gpu/drm/nouveau/nvkm/subdev/bios/volt.c:110-111: pwm_freq = nvbios_rd32(volt+0x5)/1000, pwm_range = nvbios_rd32(volt+0x16)) with no nonzero/range validation anywhere between parse and use; the parse-time /1000 also truncates any nonzero VBIOS value 1..999 to a zero divisor, a direct analogue of the seed's scaled-to-zero denominator. Secondary low-confidence site: gk104_volt_get() line 48 `bios->base + bios->pwm_range * duty / div` with div an unvalidated register read. Negative evidence: the seed's own 8*speed sites in s04 (vega10_thermal.c:310, smu7_thermal.c:270, vega20_thermal.c:194, arcturus_ppt.c:1270, smu_v13_0.c:1229) are already guarded with speed > UINT_MAX/8. Safe: gk20a.c CVB divisors are compile-time constants; r600_dpm.c:207 divides by constant 100. Limitations: exact .volt_set caller chain not traced; r600_dpm.c:227 (divisor fl) unresolved; planned ACPI/SMBIOS/EDID/DT/EEPROM and non-DRM divisor queries not executed, so negative coverage is bounded to the DRM vendor trees; no runtime reproducer built (source-only evidence).
